_comment: Crates whose runtime-budget publish refusal is deferred by an explicit decision. packages/release/publish-cargo.mjs still prints the refusal and logs the deferral; it does not hide it. Remove a crate once its budget is measured and recorded (docs/RUNTIME-BUDGETS.md).
reason: Runtime budgets deferred until the apps are cut over to the renamed crates, or measured in parallel; the P-g republish on renamed dependencies must not wait on them
